title: Super Ugly Number
goal: Solve Super Ugly Number: Find n-th number whose prime factors are in given array.
strategy: Find n-th number whose prime factors are in given array.
edgeCases: Several prime factors may produce the same next number; advance every matching candidate to avoid duplicate sequence entries.
inputRules: Use { "n": 12, "primes": [2, 7, 13, 19] }; n must be 1–24 and primes must be integers greater than 1.
